title: AppliedScientist: Automated Scientific Revision Through Iterative AI Reviewing
abstract: arXiv:2609.14738v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Automated reviewing systems are increasingly evaluated based on the quality of the reviews they produce. Yet a review is only useful if acting on it leads to a measurable improvement in the paper. We present AppliedScientist, a closed-loop system that couples an autonomous AI scientist with an AI reviewer, and evaluate it by iteratively revising rejected papers from a range of research subfields. To mirror how human authors build on earlier drafts, the AI scientist has access to its previous versions during revision. To avoid bias from prior judgments, however, each review is generated independently, with the reviewer having no memory of earlier feedback or scores. We compare three revision settings: one initialized with the original venue reviews, one initialized with AI-generated reviews, and autonomous self-revision using the same fixed prompt in every round. translated_title: AppliedScientist：通过迭代式AI审稿实现论文的自动化修订
translated_abstract: 自动化审稿系统越来越多地根据其生成的审稿意见的质量来加以评估。然而，只有当依据审稿意见进行修改能够带来论文的可衡量改进时，这些审稿意见才是有用的。我们提出了AppliedScientist，这是一个将自主AI科学家与AI审稿人耦合的闭环系统，并通过迭代修订来自多个研究子领域的被拒论文来对其进行评估。为了模拟人类作者在早期草稿基础上进行修改的方式，AI科学家在修订过程中可以访问其之前的版本。然而，为了避免先前判断带来的偏差，每次审稿都是独立生成的，审稿人对之前的反馈或评分没有任何记忆。我们比较了三种修订设置：以原始发表 venue 的审稿意见进行初始化的设置、以AI生成的审稿意见进行初始化的设置，以及每轮使用相同固定提示词的自主自我修订。由于审稿人既指导又评估修订过程，我们还评估了……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出AppliedScientist闭环系统，将自主AI科学家与独立生成审稿意见的AI审稿人相耦合，通过迭代修订被拒论文，验证依据审稿意见修改能否为论文带来可衡量的质量提升。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces AppliedScientist, a closed-loop system coupling an autonomous AI scientist with an AI reviewer whose reviews are generated independently, and evaluates it by iteratively revising rejected papers to measure whether acting on reviews yields measurable improvements in the paper.
